notes: part.rim(sk2) names the four pocket-opening edges (a pocket wall is named by the sketch side that swept it, and survives edits of the plate). Naming a wall writes the pocket as pull(sk2, -4) subtracted from the plate so the kernel can find the walls. The kernel builds the four rounds together with the corners mitred (each round extended by its radius into the corner and cut by the plane of symmetry, the two quarter cylinders meeting along an ellipse arc), which is the solid FreeCAD builds. See attempts[].
